criteria.description: Opposite CP30 activation on +/-300 TDEE cases
Correct CP30 activation by day 56 for each +/-300 case
Median correct activation latency for +/-300 cases
Noisy stationary users with a direction reversal
Mean activations per 12 weeks in ordinary stationary cases
Decrease activations in declared ambiguity scenarios
Missed CP30 change for true +/-300 TDEE cases by day 84
True +/-300 cases deferred at every checkpoint
Median status recovery after transient disturbance

notes: All results are in-model synthetic evaluation; no external or clinical validity is implied.
Sixteen users per scenario make rates coarse and do not establish population performance.
An accepted CP30 activation event is replayed as caller-owned history at the next checkpoint.
The examples directory contains two demonstration rows, not real historical log data.
The 28-day comparison changes only the decrease evidence-span gate in this harness.
